key_insight: AISPA introduces a user-centric way to audit hidden system prompts in AI applications, helping expose how commercial LLM products are instructed to behave. It aims to close the transparency and accountability gap caused by undisclosed prompt configurations.
problem_solved: Commercial AI systems often rely on system prompts that strongly shape model behavior, but these prompts are typically hidden from users, auditors, and regulators. This lack of visibility makes it difficult to assess safety, fairness, and compliance.
method: Defines Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA) as a systematic auditing framework for examining system prompts in deployed AI applications.
Focuses on user-centric audit signals to infer or evaluate prompt behavior without requiring direct disclosure from developers.
Provides a structured process for assessing whether system prompt instructions align with expected product behavior and governance goals.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, AISPA offers a practical path toward greater transparency, accountability, and trust in LLM-powered products. It can support safer deployment, better governance, and more reliable third-party auditing of AI systems.

paper_title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
paper_authors: Xiangning Lin, Shenzhe Zhu, Shu Yang, Zhenyu Zhang, Haoqian Zhang
